messages.text:
With LF fixed, the smoke run reaches real behavior differences.

The next mismatch is `stats --everything`: Rust orders `mode` before `cardinality`, and it reports `N/A` when there is no repeated modal value; I’m correcting that compatibility boundary now.

commands.commandLine: {"command":"python -m py_compile xsv_py.py; $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cmds=@('headers .tura/tmp/in.csv','count .tura/tmp/in.csv','select h2,h1 .tura/tmp/in.csv','slice -s 1 -l 1 .tura/tmp/in.csv','search a .tura/tmp/in.csv','sort -s h2 .tura/tmp/in.csv','fmt -t `t .tura/tmp/in.csv','stats --everything .tura/tmp/in.csv','frequency --limit 0 .tura/tmp/in.csv','table .tura/tmp/in.csv'); foreach($c in $cmds){ $args=$c -split ' '; & $ref @args > .tura/tmp/ref.out 2> .tura/tmp/ref.err; $rs=$LASTEXITCODE; & .\\executable.cmd @args > .tura/tmp/new.out 2> .tura/tmp/new.err; $ns=$LASTEXITCODE; if($rs -ne $ns -or (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/ref.out).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/new.out).Hash -or (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/ref.err).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash .tura/tmp/new.err).Hash){ Write-Output \"DIFF $c ref=$rs new=$ns\"; Write-Output '--- ref out'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/ref.out; Write-Output '--- new out'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/new.out; Write-Output '--- ref err'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/ref.err; Write-Output '--- new err'; Get-Content .tura/tmp/new.err; exit 1 }}; Write-Output 'smoke differential passed'","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura_workspace\\target\\project-rebuild-source-port\\r-d573c29e47\\xsv\\tura-direct-3\\workspace","timeout_ms":30000}
